items.title: David Weinstein Interview, 1988-09-22
items.q: One of them was Mr. Brown Goes to Town... These were not ones you played on.

ctx.x: What was the name of the album? That's a good question. Obviously you didn't go out and buy many jazz records. You didn't buy your own.

I had them, but these were the old shellac records and some of them busted. One of them was Mr. Brown Goes to Town. Model after the picture, Mr. Deeds Goes to Washington. I had another called Swing In, Swing Out, when the word swing was very popular. I think that's the one that did about the best. I got royalties of about 12 cents from some sales in Africa, even. I was very proud of that. These were not ones you played on. Beg your pardon?
You didn't play on these yourself. You just worked on them.
